title: malformed JSON returns the deterministic 422 json_invalid envelope
note: The envelope is Jev-compatible so a real client's error handling keeps working, which is why the body carries no fake_jev_* code. The journal still records the classification fake_jev_validation_error (§21.2, §41.7). The body is parsed as JSON regardless of the Content-Type header (§39.6). requestBody in the journal is the raw decoded string, not a parsed value, because the JSON was malformed (§41.7).

journal._timestampOmitted: timestamp is diagnostic only (§8.6, §41.7) and is not asserted

conventions.comparison: parsed JSON values; object key order and insignificant number spelling 1 versus 1.0 are not significant (§44 preamble, §39.4)
conventions.messageSentinel: the literal string <not asserted> marks a field whose value the specification does not freeze; a runner MUST skip it
